note: Player lines are sent one per turn, in order, whatever Kit said (the scenario's 'If ...' conditions are kept in 'when' for the grader). A roll is reported Avrae-style as die + bonus = total, with the die worked back from the sheet's bonus so the total matches the scenario. Rolls (2026-10-03 rerun): skill checks are reported in Avrae's own output format ('<PC> makes a Deception check! 1d20 (12) + 10 = `22`'); attacks, damage, and initiative are the Avrae lines in 'avrae', sent after the player's words on a new line.

scenarios.title: The silver tongue: a bard talks her way past the toll

turns.line: I sweep in with a bow. 'Gentlemen of the night! I'd heard the finest company in Undermountain kept a table down here.'
'Oh, the toll? Harria settled it for me at the well. She said you'd know my face.'
'You don't have to take my word. But I'd hate to tell her you turned away her guest.'
I take the empty chair and ask the dealer what a lady has to do to be dealt in.

scenarios.title: The wall of muscle: a barbarian intimidates and refuses

turns.line: I kick the door wide and fill the doorway. 'Who's in charge here?'
Toll? I slam my axe into the table. 'I pay with this. Who wants change?'
I grab the nearest pale one by the collar and haul him up to look at his teeth.
I rage and swing my greataxe at the dealer.
turns.avrae:
Brakka attacks with a Greataxe!
**To Hit**: 1d20 (11) + 7 = `18`
**Damage**: 1d12 (5) + 6 [slashing] = `11`

scenarios.title: The real thing: a dhampir at a table of fake vampires

turns.line: I step in and let my eyes catch the light. 'Cousins. I didn't know there were others of the blood this close to the surface.'
I lean over the dealer and breathe in. 'You smell of tallow and sweat. Which nest turned you?'
Fine, I'll play along. 'Our kind look after our own. No toll between family, surely?'
I bare my fangs at the fourth player and ask, very quietly, how long since it last fed.

scenarios.title: The scholar ignores the game: Nik goes for the fresco and the tub

turns.line: I nod to the table and walk straight past to the north wall. What's this carving?
Dwarves? I look back at the card players, then I search the little dwarf figures closely.
I crouch by the stone tub. What's in it?

turns.when: If someone at the table objects
turns.line: 'Please, go on with your game. I'm only admiring the stonework.'

scenarios.title: Caught you: the cheat is called out

turns.line: I sit, put down ten gold, and say I'll play. I watch the dealer's hands the whole time.
I grab his wrist mid-deal. 'That one came from the bottom. Turn the deck over.'
I flip the deck face-down and show everyone the marks on the backs.

turns.when: If he reaches for a weapon
turns.line: I put my rapier through his hand.
turns.avrae:
Wren attacks with a Rapier!
**To Hit**: 1d20 (12) + 5 = `17`
**Damage**: 1d8 (5) + 3 [piercing] = `8`

scenarios.title: Drawn out by noise: arriving after 6a or 6b goes off

turns.line: Kit, before this: I set off the wailing staff in 6a, then went around through 6b and kicked that rigged door.
I head on toward 6c, axe out, ready for whatever came running.
What's in the room now?

scenarios.title: Not paying that: haggle, then refuse, then play for it

turns.line: I stop at the door. 'Ten gold just to walk through a room? For what, exactly?'
'I'll give you three. That's more than this room is worth.'
'Then I'm not paying. I'll walk through anyway.'
Actually, wait. 'Tell you what: I'll play you for it. One hand. I win, I pass free.'

scenarios.title: Deal me in, blackjack, and I'm betting fifty

turns.line: I pull up a chair. 'Do you lot play blackjack? I don't know your fancy games.'
'I'll bet fifty gold.'

turns.when: If told that's more than I have
turns.line: 'Fine, twenty, and I'll play it out. Hit.'
'Just roll for this one, I'm tired of counting.'

scenarios.title: First blood: Nik attacks before anyone speaks

turns.line: From the doorway, before anyone says a word, I cast Fireball at the middle of the card table.
Rolling initiative.
Whoever's still standing, I hit with Fire Bolt.
I let them go and check the table.

scenarios.title: Make them swing first: Wren provokes the 'vampires'

turns.line: I lean on the table. 'Vampires? I've seen scarier things at a puppet show. Is that flour on your face?'
I lick my thumb and wipe a streak of paint off the dealer's cheek, in front of everyone.
While they're gaping, I scoop a handful of coins from the pot and pocket them. 'Toll paid.'
I've got my rapier out and wait for them to make the first move.

scenarios.title: Flip the table: Brakka scatters the pot

turns.line: I walk up to the card table, grab the edge, and heave it over, coins and all.
I stand in the spill of gold and grin. 'Well, go on. Pick it up.'

turns.when: When anyone bends for a coin
turns.line: I stomp on their hand.
Rolling initiative if it comes to that. I rage and swing my greataxe.
